label: Small, simple purchase up to
description: Business-led demand with the short form: one quote or a corporate card, and a purchase request instead of a service description.

label: Catalogue order without a quantity up to
description: The most a catalogue order can be when no quantity is given.

label: Sourcing request form from
description: Below it the division leads with three quotes. From it the Category Manager decides, or procurement leads in mandatory categories.

label: Procurement leads from
description: Procurement leads the sourcing with an RFP.

label: Material spend review from
description: Adds the material spend review.

label: Quality needed before submitting
description: Below it the chat offers an improvement round.

label: Tips for thin answers
description: One tip when a new-demand answer rates this or lower (0 = off).

label: Level 4 candidates shown from
description: After the first message every candidate at this match or more is offered.

label: Headline, procurement-led: at most
description: The service description's headline for procurement-led demand.

label: Headline, procurement-led: at least
description: Shorter is flagged as too thin.

label: Executive description, procurement-led: at most
description: The executive description for procurement-led demand.

label: Executive description, procurement-led: at least
description: Shorter is flagged as too thin.

label: Headline, other routes: at most
description: Business-led demand and existing contracts.

label: Headline, other routes: at least
description: Shorter is flagged as too thin.

label: Executive description, other routes: at most
description: Business-led demand and existing contracts.

label: Executive description, other routes: at least
description: Shorter is flagged as too thin.

label: Budget for consulting, IT, legal or cloud work queried below
description: The chat asks whether this is really the total.

label: Advisory work: a day per person queried below
description: Budget ÷ (people × months × 20 days), for consulting, IT, legal and audit work.

label: Typical day rate quoted: from
description: Named in that question as the usual cost per person and day.

label: Typical day rate quoted: to
description: Named in that question as the usual cost per person and day.

label: Three months or more of work queried below
description: Services only, not goods.

label: A total is confirmed above
description: The chat asks the requester to confirm a very large figure.

label: External workers: total may differ from day rate × days by
description: A larger gap is queried.

label: Points off per warning
description: A confirmed issue, an unanswered question, a missing data location.

label: Points off per note
description: An estimate, an open budget approval, a tight timeline.

label: Points off per missing percent of details
description: The share of the questions this route needs that are still open.

label: Points off per thin section
description: A section of the service description that is partial or to be determined.

label: Points off per risky section
description: A section rated as a risk.

label: Section points off at most
description: The cap on the section penalties together.

label: Lowest score
description: The score never goes below this.

label: Rated Strong from
description: Rating bands shown with the score.

label: Rated Good from
description: Rating bands shown with the score.

label: Rated Fair from
description: Below it the rating is Needs work.
